data.title: 和栗薰子 · 烟花下收好的金鱼袋
data.description: 夏祭河岸，薰子穿蓝色朝颜花浴衣与黄色腰带，黑紫长发别着小花簪。她双手小心托住金鱼袋，听见烟花升空后抬起头，蓝色眼睛映着一瞬光亮，笑容因为惊喜变得更灿烂。
data.action: 双手托稳金鱼袋，听见烟花升空后惊喜抬头。
data.lighting: warm lantern fill and distant fireworks
data.promptProse: At the festival riverbank, Kaoruko Waguri holds her goldfish bag carefully in both hands, lifting her head when the first fireworks rise. Blue morning glories decorate her sky-blue yukata above a yellow obi, small floral clips securing her blackish-purple hair. The medium portrait keeps river railing and lantern stalls behind. Warm lantern fill illuminates the bag and smile, while distant fireworks make a brief bright reflection in her blue eyes and the water.
